data.title: 三司绫濑 · 卸下伪装的枕边轻靠
data.description: 关掉顶灯的卧室里只余床头一盏柔光小灯，绫濑抱着软枕侧靠在床头，幽蓝蕾丝波浪边与米白被单映出沉静反差。没有客套的营业微笑，她只是轻轻拉住你的袖口，垂着眼睫小声说「今晚就这样多陪我聊一会儿吧」。
data.location: 柔暗温暖的深夜卧室床头软枕间
data.action: 侧靠床头抱枕轻拉身侧衣角，垂眸带着真实柔意
data.lighting: 床头小灯低饱和暖光洒在肩头与深蓝蕾丝上
data.camera: 近景略俯，突出眼神真诚与亲密氛围
data.mood: 卸防、依赖、真挚而微颤的心动
data.promptProse: Resting back against soft cream pillows in the dim glow of her bedside lamp, Ayase lets her polished public smile fade into genuine warmth. Her deep-blue sheer lace camisole contrasts softly against the pale bedding as she gazes up with quiet trust and a faint flush.
data.animaCaption: Leaning against cream pillows by a dim bedside lamp, she looks up with quiet trust and a faint blush.
data.nsfwProse: Delicate scalloped deep-blue lace rests lightly against her collarbone and waist amid the rumpled pale sheets.
